# SEO-074: Expose a finite pagination path to the last page of every sequence

## Statement

Every paginated sequence can be traversed to its final page by following hrefs, and requesting a page number beyond the end returns a not-found status rather than an empty successful page.

## Rationale

A sequence with no reachable end, or one that answers 200 for any page number, presents an endless supply of near-empty addresses and hides the items on the real later pages behind an unbounded walk.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site",
    "pagination"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Compute the total page count when rendering the control and stop emitting a next link at the end. Validate the requested page number against that total in the route handler and return 404 when it exceeds the total.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Follow next links from the first page of a sequence until they stop, then request one page beyond the final number and record the status returned.
- Evidence: `ROUTE`, `HTTP_STATUS`, `RENDERED_HTML`
- Automated check: none.
